nights.title: Dan and Phil – Hard Launch World Tour
nights.name: Dan and Phil
nights.extract: Dan and Phil are an English entertainment and business duo, consisting of partners Daniel Howell and Phil Lester. They are best known for their collaborative work on YouTube since meeting in 2009. Additionally, they have collaborated on television and radio presenting, books, tours, and original films.

nights.title: Turnover
nights.name: Turnover
nights.extract: Turnover is an American rock band from Virginia Beach, Virginia. The band were formed in 2009 by brothers Austin and Casey (drums) Getz alongside longtime friend Danny Dempsey (bass); the three have gone on to oversee every iteration of the band to date. The three are currently joined in the band by lead guitarist Nick Rayfield, who began touring with the band in 2017 and was later officially inducted as a full-time member in 2022. Turnover have released six studio albums and four EPs across their career. Their most recent album, Down on Earth, was released on May 29th 2026.

nights.title: Bill Bailey - Vaudevillean
nights.name: Bill Bailey
nights.extract: Mark Robert "Bill" Bailey is an English musician, comedian, actor and television presenter. He is known for his role as Manny in the sitcom Black Books (2000–2004), and for his regular appearances on the panel shows Never Mind the Buzzcocks, Have I Got News for You, and QI, as well as for his stand-up comedy work. He plays a variety of musical instruments and incorporates music into his performances.
